footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Tenet: after $960M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.1% to $21.3B in 2025. Operating income fell 41.1% to $3.5B, a 16.5% margin.
Net income fell 56.0% to $1.4B, or $15.49 per share. Operating cash flow was $3.5B and free cash flow $2.5B, versus $1.1B; Tenet returned $1.4B through buybacks.
sources: Tenet Healthcare Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
